program_name: Ledger Affiliate programme (Ledger | Affiliate, partners page) — hardware/Ledger products; CL Card not stated as commissionable
legal_entity: Ledger SAS, 106 rue du Temple, 75003 Paris, France (site footer; not stated in programme terms, which were not readable).
application_conditions: Partners page: 'You are a blogger, a Youtuber, an influencer or have a voice in the crypto world? Become a Ledger affiliate and be rewarded for promoting our products.' CTA to www.ledgerwallet.com/affiliates (not fetched). The programme portal affiliate.ledger.com returned a client error to the fetcher; no terms, rates or conditions could be read.
paid_action: Not stated on the pages read ('Attractive commissions in crypto', 'Direct relation with Ledger', 'Early access to Ledger news'). Which products are commissionable is not stated; the CL Card appears on the partners page only in site navigation, never in an affiliate context. A separate Ledger 'Refer a Friend' programme (shop.ledger.com referral terms) exists for hardware purchases — not read.

commission.model_note: 'Attractive commissions in crypto' — no rate, no product list. The CL Card is provided by Baanx/Crypto Life, not sold by Ledger; whether card sign-ups pay anything is unknown.

payout.method: 'commissions in crypto' (partners page) — details not stated

rules_note: No channel rules, prohibited promotion rules or country restrictions readable this run. Crypto Life's own site has only a 'Partner FAQ' for wallet integrators (withcl.com/faq-partners) and no publisher programme; Baanx UK's legal page lists no affiliate document.
